text: player
Haruna Igarashi
Welcome to our coffee shop!
The little barista greets the never-ending flow of customers with a bright and energetic smile.
Today is Charity Day at Haruna's school. Unfortunately, her parents couldn't make it, so they asked me to accompany her. Yet just as I was about to record the little barista's dazzling performance...
Customer A
Haruna, is my Heart Latte ready?
C-Coming! Heart... Heart... You can do this! It's just a heart! Easy-peasy! Steady as a surgeon... Argh! It's all weird again!
Customer B
Haruna, is my toast done?
N-NOOO! It's burnt black! N-No problem! I'll make another! One second!
Relax, kiddo. Just make me any coffee you feel like. Have fun with it!
Have fun? Hehe! Haruna's got you covered!!
Haruna rushes off to the freezer to get a bag of popsicles, then grabs a shaker.
Oh? Isn't that your favorite – popsicles?
Watch closely! First, put a popsicle in the shaker, add some coffee, cover it with the lid, and then shake it just like this!
EEEEK! NOOOOOOO!
Luckily, the customers survived the "coffee bomb" unscathed. Haruna and I bowed and apologized while cleaning up the aftermath.
That was a little unexpected... Haruna?
Haruna! Wait!
Where are you going?
Waah... I tried my best, but nothing worked...
I don't want to drag everyone down with me.
Comfort Haruna and ask her what's wrong.
Leave the place with Haruna.
Is it really all right to just leave?
I-It's fine! It's all for fun anyway! I-I don't even care!
Oh? That's not what your mother told me.
Huh?
Mrs. Igarashi
She's been so hard at work preparing a "surprise" for the grown-ups.
Mahjong Soul Shrine - Mahjong Room
It's actually quite a pity that we can't make it. If it's not too much trouble, could you film Haruna a bit? It'd mean a lot to have those memories to look back on.
Leave it to me! I'll get tons of footage of Haruna in action.
If you really didn't care, you wouldn't have spent so much time preparing, right?
Well...
So, what is it? You're not a kid who gives up easily.
It's because... I planned to attract customers at the door with my Kitty Warriors.
Oh, that's a great idea! Kitties and Haruna... Double the cuteness – what a delight!
Haruna looks down in silence, so I cautiously ask while watching the defeated figure of the little cat boss.
Did something happen to Kitty Warriors?
Waah...
They were such good kitties during training! But today... They won't even touch their cans. They're all hiding and ignoring me...
There are too many people here today.
Maybe the cats have "social phobia."
The cats have all been fed.
R-Right! Everyone's so busy with all the customers today.
The kitties are super shy. They'd never touch any snacks from a stranger! O-Oh! They must be scared!
Everyone's swamped with customers today.
S-So attracting customers kinda wasn't needed anymore, and I got called over to help out with the coffee instead.
I tried my best to learn, but... Coffee, cooking... They're all such difficult tasks. And I can't take my time either...
Ah, that explains it. It makes sense that you're lacking the know-how when you were brought in so suddenly.
Training cats is much harder than learning to brew coffee. I'm sure you want the event to go well, right?
Yes! I really, really do!
Wouldn't you have regrets if we left just like this?
But I couldn't do anything. If I stay, I'll just cause more trouble.
Things might not be the way you think.
I open the photo album titled "Haruna's Event Materials" on my phone and play the snippets of conversation from customers passing by.
That kid called Haruna is such a cutie. I really want her to make me a cute coffee!
She's still getting the hang of it, but she's putting her heart into every drink she makes. She's so energetic! There's just something about her energy that's so lovable.
Huh?! Th-They're praising me?!
I-I didn't let everyone down?!
Nope! And they're even waiting for you to do better.
R-Really?!
So, are you going to head back in there and give it another go?
Uh... Well... {var:player_nickname}, can I call on you if I need help?
Of course, feel free.
Hmm... Let me think about it.
Wow! Okay! I trust you, {var:player_nickname}!
{var:player_nickname}! You liar! I know you so well! You'd never say no to helping me!
Yup, there's the Haruna I know.
Hmph! I'm gonna get it done! Even if it kills me!
Uh... You don't have to go that far, right?
Hey... {var:player_nickname}... It's so strange. Why aren't there any customers?
Yeah, what's going on?
Now that she's back, Haruna is itching to welcome the challenge again. However, the coffee shop has lost most of its customers.
Is no one coming because of my failures?
Of course not. Stay positive.
Student A
I know what's going on! The milk tea shop next door is holding a performance, and almost all the customers have gone there!
Student B
Now that they've had milk tea, I doubt they'll come for coffee, right?
Class President
Ugh! We've got to figure something out! Sigh, we had such a great idea...
Student C
Haruna, are your cats still unwilling to come?
Their home, the woods behind our school, the grocery store... I've looked everywhere, but I haven't found a single furball...
Sad. I'm sure we'd get lots of customers if the cats were here!
Yeah! That performance with them waving paws was so adorable! Haruna even went to such great lengths to prepare it all...
If only I was a better boss for them...
What are you talking about? You're amazing! You had to train the cats and help out at the coffee shop!
Exactly! Everyone knows how hard you've worked!
Everyone...
I guess we have to forget the cats... Anyone else have any ideas?
The kids look at each other, yet none can provide an answer.
Looks like there's no other way.
Will we keep losing customers if this goes on?
Well... It's alright. We've done our best, so let's just keep doing our best until the end.
Students
Okay...
Honestly, I'm just not feeling it anymore...
Well, it's not like we've got customers lining up. Might as well just wing it.
I have a question, {var:player_nickname}.
Haruna sneaks over to my side and gazes hesitantly at me.
Everyone seems so listless... {var:player_nickname}, do you think we made the right decision?
Your class president isn't wrong.
What do you think?
Haruna, why don't you just ask yourself?
Ask myself?
Well, if you're asking me that, it means you already have an answer, don't you?
Haruna thinks for a moment.
I just... don't want everyone to be sad.
I was feeling pretty down too. I couldn't bring the kitties here, and I failed at making coffee...
I was so down in the dumps that even the coffee I made turned out bitter and totally gross!
Don't doubt your coffee, Haruna. Maybe that's just how it's supposed to taste.
Hehe! I couldn't have snapped out of it without you and everyone!
Working together at our coffee shop makes me so happy!
See? It's not as bad as you think.
Right now, they're just like how I was before. There isn't an ounce of motivation left in them... I know how that feels.
I want to spend the time we have left enjoying ourselves making coffee together...
That's what I think. No, it's my wish!
It's a great wish. Maybe it's your turn to encourage them now.
D-Do you think I can do it?
Of course you can.
Sincerity is your greatest power!
Okay! I trust you, {var:player_nickname}!
Haruna takes a deep breath and dashes to her classmates.
Hey, guys!

Her energetic shout grabs everyone's attention – whether they are making coffee, baking desserts, chatting in groups, lost in manga, or snoozing in the corner. All eyes are on Haruna, who's standing at the center of the classroom.
Haruna, do you need something?
No... I have something to say!
Haruna looks at me, feeling the weight of her classmates' gazes on her.
You can do it! Be brave and express yourself!
I think it's too soon to give up!
Our coffee shop is awesome! It's here to bring joy to so many people! And the money we make will allow so many kids to enjoy delicious popsicles!
Our customers are happy! And all of you... Your smiles while working so hard were absolutely beautiful! I haven't had enough of them!
Please! Everyone! Even if we don't have any customers, let's keep giving it our best until the end and brew coffee with smiles on our faces! Because I love the way you smile so much!
S-So... I want us to make this wish come true together! I-I'm sure we can spread the joy to so many others!
Standing at the center of the classroom, Haruna sincerely expresses her wish to all her classmates and ends her speech with a bow.
All Students
Phew! That was a scare! I thought you might've done something worse than burning the toast...
At least Haruna is not bombing the classroom! Thank goodness...
Huh?!
The silence in the room was broken by a few jokes.
I see... What do the rest of you think?
Why don't we give it another try? After all, it's not every day we see Haruna getting so serious.
Student D
Well, I guess we don't have a choice. At least not after that speech.
The event isn't over until the fat lady sings! Come on! Let's hand out the flyers and "steal" their customers!
Alright, while there are no customers, let's give the tables and chairs another wipe!
Inspired by Haruna's words, the kids jump into action and get to work.
{var:player_nickname}, I did it!
Yes, you did well, Haruna.
Haruna, could you help me? I'm considering trying out some new coffee flavors.
Okay! You know, I've prepared lots of popsicles! And they come in all sorts of flavors. I'm sure they can become good friends with coffee and make lots of different combinations!
Popsicles? And coffee?!
Yup! Sounds pretty awesome, right?
As Haruna dedicates herself wholeheartedly to the coffee shop, I take out my phone and start filming her.
I knew it! Popsicles and coffee are a match made in heaven!

Haruna's new creation, Popsicle Coffee, quickly gains popularity among adults due to its novelty and unique flavor. With the help of her classmates, their coffee shop soon wins back its customers. The students, the customers – well, everyone there is all smiles. Donations are also on the rise...
Hehe! I didn't expect everyone to come together and make my wish come true! I'm so happy!
I'm not surprised at all.
Because you're always such a bright light, Haruna.
Because you always lift everyone's spirits, Haruna.
Really? Then that's how I feel about you too, {var:player_nickname}!
I'd have been long gone if you hadn't been there to encourage me, {var:player_nickname}. Now, I dub you my "Super God of Popsicles"!
Pfft! What's that supposed to mean?
The God of Popsicles is my protector!
I'm always happy knowing the God of Popsicles is there to look out for me.
But now, I have a good friend in you, {var:player_nickname}!
I haven't gone a day without being happy since I met you, {var:player_nickname}! And I've done so many new things too!
I think I'm really, really happy right now!
So, that means... You're better than the God of Popsicles, {var:player_nickname}! That's why you're the Super God of Popsicles!
Pinky promise!
I link my pinky with Haruna's.
Then it's a promise! And it lasts for a hundred years!
Well, it's like your class president said. You've all done your best.
Oh, I see...
Haruna nodded, though she didn't seem to have fully grasped the meaning of it.
Then what do you think I should do now, {var:player_nickname}?
Just focus on what's in front of you for now. I can't wait to try the coffee you brew.
Hmm, okay! I can do it!
Gradually, Haruna gets better and better at her work.
Welcome!
We hope you had a great time!
Come again next time!
Even though there aren't many customers right now, she takes advantage of every opportunity, and her coffee improves with each cup she makes.
Haruna, look. All you need is the right technique and the popsicle and coffee won't spill out of the shaker.
Wow! Okay! I'll get a popsicle!
Just as Haruna is about to rush to the freezer, the bell rings, and their teacher walks into the room.
Teacher
Everyone, that's it for our Charity Day.
Huh?
It seems the event has come to an end before anyone even realizes it.
But I still wanna try making popsicle coffee!
It's already pretty amazing that you've perfected your Heart Latte so soon.
I see... But we lost so many customers to the class next door. If only I had mastered the Heart Latte sooner, maybe we'd have even more customers!
Ugh! Forget it! I'm really, really gonna show everyone on the next Charity Day!
I wonder what the theme will be next time! I want to start practicing at home already!
Hmm... Desserts? Sushi? I hope it isn't grilled fish... Well, it might be chocolate!
I don't even know how chocolate is made. Hmph! Chocolate Demon, I, the brave Haruna, swear to defeat you!
Returning to her lively self, Haruna dives into her imagination.
Okay, I'll help you ask your teacher for leave. Let's just skip this Charity Day and go have some fun instead.
Huh? Skip the event?
Yes. Your mother asked me to take good care of you.
How about we head to the amusement park? Maybe it can cheer you up a bit?
(whispering) Hmm... Having fun is better than causing trouble. Okay, let's go have some fun!
O-Oh, right! I have a wish. Could you help me with it, {var:player_nickname}?
Go ahead.
Haruna's wish was for me to buy two cups of coffee from the coffee shop. Afterward, I took her to the amusement park, but she still seemed down.
What's on your mind, Haruna?
Mmm... {var:player_nickname}. Using my allowance to buy coffee counts as helping out, right?
Of course. And thanks for the coffee too.
Did you enjoy it, {var:player_nickname}?
It wasn't bad. But I think I would have preferred a cup made by you.
Huh?! But I still can't make a proper cup of coffee...
It's alright. It's just something I'm looking forward to.
I see... Waah! I knew it! I was a complete failure today...
Your careless words have made her sad again. Haruna droops her head and falls silent.
It seems taking her out to have some fun isn't the answer to making her feel better.
Okay, I'll be your Super God of Popsicles.
